subject.title: Add Rovo Dev provider with monthly credit tracking

question: Should CodexBar ship an experimental Rovo Dev provider that relies on Atlassian's undocumented credits/check endpoint and Basic-auth behavior?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a line-level patch defect; it is whether maintainers accept an undocumented external provider contract without successful paid-account proof in the current discussion.

options.title: Hold for proof and contract sign-off
options.body: Require successful latest-head paid-account credit proof and explicit maintainer acceptance before merge.

options.title: Accept disabled experimental risk
options.body: Merge with experimental labeling and own the risk that Atlassian rejects or changes the endpoint for normal accounts.

options.title: Pause for a CLI/site-aware path
options.body: Keep the related provider request open until real CLI usage fixtures or a supported API make the integration less speculative.

recommendation.title: Hold for proof and contract sign-off
recommendation.body: Require successful latest-head paid-account credit proof and explicit maintainer acceptance before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has already made the provider-contract hold explicit in PR comments and authored the recent Rovo hardening commits.
